Claim 1 (Currently amended): A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: a computing device including a processor coupled to a system memory, the system memory storing instructions for execution on the processor, the instructions configured to cause the processor to: retrieve a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain; analyze the network data to identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat, wherein the mitigating action is performed in response to the identification of the malicious network threat.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to push a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device, the notification being generated only after the malicious network threat has been identified.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): A method for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: retrieving a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain; analyzing the network data to identify a malicious network threat; and performing a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat, wherein the mitigating action is performed in response to the identification of the malicious network threat.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The method of claim 10, further comprising pushing a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device, the notification being generated only after the malicious network threat has been identified.
